story.title: Come Let Us Play!
paragraphs_en: Mona came wearing a PURPLE skirt
Seema! Even I want to play the Singing Game
The Girl in the brown frock told "First you answer our questions , then only you can play with us!"
'Ask!' said the girl in the purple skirt. "How many fingers are these?"
"There are 10 fingers,5 in one hand and 5 more in another hand" She answered
"What do we call this?" The girl in the purple skirt replied "That is called as Nose"
"What do we call this as?" asked the girl wearing the pink frock "This is called as Tongue. It helps us to taste food"
"What do we call this as?" asked the girl wearing the yellow frock. Mona answered quickly, "This is called as Ear. It helps us to hear".
"And these are my Legs , witch help us all to walk and run."
'Oh! You know everything" said Seema ,"now you can play the singing game with us!" And they all started playing Anthakshari.
